title: Radar Target
source_docs: Phased Array System Toolbox/Environment and Target/Radar_Target.md
text: Radar Target，输入 3 路、输出 1 路；按 {Fluctuation model} 指定Fluctuation model；{Source of mean radar cross section}、{Mean radar cross section (m^2)}、{Propagation speed (m/s)} 指定信号传播速度 physconst、{Operating frequency (Hz)} 指定工作频率 3e8、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。
